bio.text: Robert Garcia is a member of the California State Assembly for District 50 and lives in Rancho Cucamonga with his wife and three children.

Before the Assembly, he spent more than 20 years in education as a classroom teacher and school administrator, and was elected to the Etiwanda School District Board of Trustees in 2016 and re-elected in 2020, serving as Board President.
Garcia earned a bachelor's degree in biology from UCLA and a master's degree in public policy from the University of Southern California.
